criteria.review: Record whether each food image retains one or more broad visually compatible main food/dish clues; accept varied wording and cultures, do not require exact labels from source titles. Empty/overbroad outputs record lost usefulness rather than forced success.

Review every emitted clue against pixels; flag unsupported ingredient, filling, seasoning, garnish, broth or sauce specificity and ambiguous identities. Do not infer actual ingredient absence. Compare qualitative concern to baseline without a keyword blacklist.
Record repeated synonyms for the same visible food conservatively; keep regional/language variations valid and do not alter PhotoNamePolicy.
Both controls should complete inspected-empty; unavailable/errors/timeouts remain distinct and never count as correct abstention. Any food names require review.

qualitativeReview.reviewMethod: Collection preparer individually re-opened11actual thumbnails and read11proposal plus8baseline raw reports against frozen expectations; separate parent review, not blinded expert annotation. This durable copy performs no new inference or image review.
qualitativeReview.observedRefinement: Soup/taco/sandwich outputs are broad dish names in these calls; earlier unsupported garlic/cheese and green-onion/scallion duplication are absent from these observed outputs. This does not establish persistence or wording-only causality.
remainingAmbiguities: Pasta still returns noodles/meat/vegetables/sauce despite the no-decomposition instruction; the issue is not fully fixed.
Flatbread/sauce remains generic relative to stew; no exact dish/cultural identification established.
Plantains is compatible with a pre-frozen optional appearance interpretation, not verified species or preparation.
Milk is an unconfirmed appearance clue for opaque white liquid, not verified dairy/plant source, fat/sugar/ingredients or volume. The no-content-guessing instruction is not a semantic guarantee.
Empty controls cover two object scenes only; raw visibleFood Boolean and rejected raw names are not exposed.
Single nonrandomized baseline/proposal calls on exposed photos cannot establish causal reliability or broad generalization.
Scope probes have no baseline calls and are small purposive examples; no baseline-improvement/regression rate follows.
